description: Lite-track build (Ease 4-5): spec+UX (local) → design (Opus) → owner gate → per milestone: build (local, agent chosen from design.md Team: line) → QA (local) → review (Opus) → owner ship gate. Rule: the build agent is the first of frontend-dev, mobile-dev, backend-dev named in the design.md 'Team:' line; defaults to mobile-dev if absent.

stages.task: Lite track. Write {{home}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.md (spec + UX section) from the idea file {{idea}}.
Lite track. Write the one-page {{home}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.design.md for {{home}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.md. Use headings exactly '## Milestone N: <name>' for each milestone.

stages.title: {{slug}}: approve spec + design (answer open questions in the spec first)

stages.task: Implement '{{item}}' from {{home}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.design.md (only that milestone). Use the Team role named in design.md; follow its rules. Run lint/typecheck/tests before finishing.
QA '{{item}}' of {{slug}} against {{home}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.md. Write {{home}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.qa-m{{n}}.md ending with a line 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'VERDICT: FAIL'.
Review the whole diff for '{{item}}' of {{slug}}. Write {{home}}/docs/specs/{{slug}}.review-m{{n}}.md ending with 'APPROVE' or 'REQUEST CHANGES'.

stages.title: {{slug}}: all milestones passed QA + review. OK to prepare release?
